papers.what_it_is: A hybrid quantum-classical branch-and-cut-and-price method for optimal multi-agent path finding that solves restricted master problems as QUBOs, with an optimality criterion and experiments on the MovingAI benchmark and a D-Wave annealer.

existing.value: The authors state that they present the first optimal hybrid quantum-classical MAPF algorithms and that experiments suggest their approach dominates previous QUBO formulations and state-of-the-art MAPF solvers. The authors report that QP-ILP almost always outperforms the best performing baselines LNS2 and LaCAM*, which are better for 100 agents on room-64-64-8, and that QP-ILP is almost always optimal except for maze-32-32-4.
